desc: 粉台悬浮开场、反光织带机制与结构标注的犬用胸背带牵引绳详情长图款
leaf: 中小型犬反光尼龙胸背带牵引绳
name: 反光尼龙犬胸背带牵引绳款

shots.intent: 用粉台悬浮开场，一秒给出可购理由并确立整套色系与图标语言。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline block: eyebrow line, two-line headline, one rounded pill row of four short tags

shots.intent: 先放大夜间遛行时织带不被看见的真实情境，为下一镜的反光机制铺垫。
把三项核心主张压成一排圆标卡片，供手机端下滑一眼读完。
shots.textZone: headline block above the card, three icon labels inside the card

shots.intent: 解释反光机制：一条沿缝线走行的环形反射光，让卖点变成看得见的结构。
shots.textZone: lower-left headline with one small sub-label

shots.intent: 用织带与内芯绳股的微距质感证明做工，替代不可验证的数据。
shots.textZone: right-hand column of three label blocks with pill captions

shots.intent: 编号指向四个真实可见构造点，回答它凭什么好用。
shots.textZone: top legend lines plus four numbered circular markers on the product

shots.intent: 把装备放回日常居家情境，让买家代入自家犬只。
把可选配色与材质小样并列平铺，让买家一次完成选择。
shots.textZone: one caption pill under each unit and one under each material chip

shots.intent: 用表格版式正面回答怎么选码，数值全部留给运行时填入。
shots.textZone: headline block, four column headers, four rows of table cells

shots.intent: 用五金、卡扣与双排缝线的近景承担信任，绝不引入证书与检测号。
shots.textZone: one short label under each of the three crops

shots.intent: 以同色系悬浮收尾并留一枚按钮位，完成详情长图的行动收口。
shots.textZone: top headline plus one rounded button beneath the product

style.backgroundSystem: seamless matte blush panels with one cylindrical display pedestal and rounded-corner cream card grids; the single night shot may use the reserved warm-brown panel only
style.direction: soft blush studio pet-gear detail page
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons inside filled circular chips in the accent tone, one label per chip, no 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused key from the upper left, low contrast, gentle contact shadow that always touches the ground plane; macro shots add one raking accent to reveal weave
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page set; fixed palette of soft blush-beige panel #F1E6DF, cream infographic cards #FBF6F1, deep charcoal type #2D2D2D and one terracotta-pink accent #D79A89, with one reserved warm-brown night panel #40332F used only on the single low-light shot; warm neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif with a small-caps latin eyebrow line and one thin hairline rule beneath it; consistent background system of seamless matte blush panels plus one cylindrical display pedestal and rounded-corner cream card grids; soft diffused studio key from the upper left, low contrast, gentle contact shadows that always touch the ground plane; matte woven nylon webbing, padded honeycomb mesh and brushed metal hardware rendered crisply; layout system of centered headline block, rounded pill tags, filled circular icon chips, numbered circular callouts and thin hairline table rules; thin-line icon style; stable product scale with the product either floating in its open wearing loop or laid flat overhead; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no warm-brown night panel outside the single night shot
no real numbers, units or certification marks unless supplied at generation time

palette.name: 夜场暖褐（仅低光镜使用）

style.presentationRules: product either floats suspended in its open wearing loop over the pedestal or lies flat overhead; scale stays stable between shots; reflective stitched seams are the recurring visual motif; keep the same front 3/4 geometry as the hero
style.surfaceSystem: matte blush tabletop, cream paper cards, brushed metal hardware and woven nylon webbing with padded honeycomb mesh
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; small-caps latin eyebrow line, one thin hairline rule under it, bold two-line Chinese headline, rounded pill tags; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and always a placeholder
